stem: Which management strategy is specifically recommended for adolescents with Delayed Sleep Phase Disorder?

options.text: Rescheduling bedtime by moving it half an hour earlier each week
Allowing long daytime naps to compensate for late-night wakefulness
Encouraging high-intensity exercise immediately before the new bedtime
Immediate surgical intervention for enlarged tonsils

explanation: Gradually shifting the bedtime earlier helps realign the internal circadian rhythm with the desired societal schedule.
rationale: Think about techniques used to gradually reset a biological clock.

optionExplanations.A: Gradually shifting the bedtime earlier helps realign the internal circadian rhythm with the desired societal schedule.
optionExplanations.B: Daytime naps are discouraged as they can reduce sleep pressure and further delay the ability to fall asleep at night.
optionExplanations.C: Vigorous activity before bed can be stimulating and may make it more difficult to fall asleep.
optionExplanations.D: Surgery addresses anatomical obstructions (OSA), not the circadian rhythm issues found in Delayed Sleep Phase Disorder.

source.hint: Think about techniques used to gradually reset a biological clock.
